notes.title: Custom Mode Major Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, 

I'm excited to annouce that a major update for the game is now live![/p][p][/p][p]This update includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Custom mode[/b] is now polished and available in the base game. [/p][/*][*][p]When reaching the end of the wave, all basic keys can be destroyed with one click.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaning up and polishing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Custom mode gives you the freedom to modify your runs to your taste. It gives you a granular level of settings and options.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you need to explore specific key mechanics or create a new run, the custom mode will give you that![/p][p][/p][p]Here are some screenshots for the editor:[/p][p][/p][h3]The basic setting of the run:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/cc44b76ab06425884497542c95a225a5623d6053.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The event setting of the run:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/946bb8edd2b98f92d7a9fb2496a644d42f308438.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A curve-based logic, to have fine control for spawn settings:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/9df66242a393c95f7f7dbe9e8f2a466cf89d8805.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]You can go crazy with it, like:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/c187b45e10d75b16dff97af8b1b9e9cf61674f55.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]or[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/dcb6cfdb19a42a5d472b99ae9eac3889b5630ebc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy it!
-Ali.[/p]

notes.title: Custom mode beta build is now live
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you are having a lovely day!
[/p][p]The beta build of the custom mode is now live.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/cc44b76ab06425884497542c95a225a5623d6053.png"][/img][/p][h2][i]
How to Join?[/i][/h2][p]Anyone can join and test the custom mode. You can join it by following these steps: [/p][olist][*][p]Open your Steam Client app[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Library[/b] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Go to the game [b]Keytamine[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Right click -> Properties[/p][/*][*][p]Then go to Betas[/p][/*][*][p]Finally, select from the [b]Beta Participation[/b] drop-down:[/p][p] [b][u]beta_custom Beta build for testing the new custom mode.[/u][/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/ca6f672475efb6a16a4ccabcde0e9780bf520957.png"][/img]
[/p][p]I will go through the level editor in much detail in the next update, but now I will provide some insights. [/p][p][/p][p]The custom mode will allow you to modify many settings, like:[/p][list][*][p]Waves count and wave duration. [/p][/*][*][p]What things are spawned and control their spawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Regular and Elite keys settings (Damage, health, speed, move rate)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These settings are flexible, and they can allow to have somewhat crazy, unbalanced settings. This is intentional, so it gives the player some fun time.

The beta version should work with your current save file without issue. 

If you found an issue, please report it in the community.

Hope you enjoy it!
-Ali.[/p]

notes.title: Keytamine Devlog #1 - Post Steam Fest
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

I want to start this post by thanking the [b]3,300[/b] players who played [b]Keytamine[/b]!

It was amazing to interact with you all! 

Also, special thanks to all people who wishlist it, left a review, or posted in the community hub, it means a lot :D

The reception of the demo far exceeded the expectations, especially since it hadn't had sufficient prior wishlist/cover before joining the Steam Next Fest.

If you played the demo and liked it, please don't forget to leave a review, whether positive or negative. All feedback helps improve the experience even further.

If you haven't played the demo yet, you can play it here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738020/Keytamine_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]Okay, now you've played the demo, but are you unsure what the final game will look like? You basically experienced around %15% of the final game, there's a huge amount of more content, mainly of:
[/p][list][*][p]Special Keys[/p][/*][*][p]Worlds[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetics[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please read the previous devlog if you want to know more about these terms:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3614980/view/545611272206418705?l=english"][/dynamiclink] 

This is a teaser of two new special keys:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/18020bfe4b7dc5c0b27c332d2c33f94719c38d1d.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/61a6393cc597b2eb0cf289c5aecbcb3bf40d25b8.gif"][/img]

Happy Gaming![/p][p]- Ali.
[/p]

notes.title: Keytamine Devlog #0 - What is this?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!  I want to write this log to introduce Keytamine to the players. What it is, and what its plans are. [/p][p]As the game's short description:[/p][p][i]Keytamine is a satisfying action game where you auto-click unique keycap enemies in a fast-paced, rhythmic battle! It supports both engaging survivor-like and relaxed modes. Basically a video game ASMR ![/i][/p][p]
The core idea of Keytamine is having an incremental progression, with new, fresh mechanics and scenery after every level. The plan is to have 11 levels (0-10), and around 14 maps. You start simple, then you achieve the most chaotic level. Level 0 will be a relaxed, deathless, slightly longer level.

My plan isn't to have extremely fast, uncontrolled gameplay, instead, I need to focus more on players' decisions, like should I interact with the health dealer now, or later? And how much should I gamble? 

Speaking of the Health Dealer, there are 3 main categories of keys:

[/p][list][*][p] Basic Keys
[/p][/*][*][p] Elite Keys
[/p][/*][*][p] Special Keys
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Basic keys are, well, basic. Their main functionality is to provide experience to the player, and oppose a basic threat.

Elites are like basic keys, but way stronger; one elite key may be equal to 200 basic keys.

Special keys, such as the Health Dealer, will play a major part in game progression, with each level introducing a new set of special keys. These keys may be:

[/p][list][*][p] Pure Helper keys (Like Loot Crates)
[/p][/*][*][p] Decision-based keys (Like Health Dealer)
[/p][/*][*][p] Aggressive keys (Like Wizard)
[/p][/*][/list][p]
In the demo, currently, you have only 4 special keys, but the total special keys is 16 (I may add more as I work on it). 

Another part of the game progression will be the tools, all demo tools are passive, which means they work by themselves (You can switch to manual clicking using Tab, though), but there are 3 more active tools in the development build.

The plan is to have a very compact experience. Contrary to the demo, the final game will start with shorter sessions, around 6-8 minutes, and go up to longer sessions, around 30-40 minutes.

The game foundation is already done, so you can expect major updates very fast and very soon. The planned release date is around July-Aug, so it's very soon :D.

That's it for this log. I'm planning to have 1-2 more logs before the release, to keep things updated.



In the next demo build, we will have 2 new features:

[/p][list][*][p] Added session progression HUD, now you can know how many waves are left to finish the run.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a camera controls tutorial, I reviewed let's play videos of Keytamine, and some of them weren't aware of the camera control using the Middle Mouse Button, so I added that.
[/p][/*][*][p] (Extra note) I'm not sure if this fix has already been uploaded, but the UI now works with most of the screens, including wide screens! 
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Happy gaming!
- Ali.[/p]

notes.title: Demo hot fix!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

You may have encountered a bug recently where you can't start a new run because of a "screen freeze" after you completed the round. Thanks for the players " [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3614980/discussions/0/603031621173542596/]2333[/url] " and a redditor named "rattlesnakethib" for pointing this out!

I've uploaded a hotfix to resolve this issue. My apologies for the inconvenience.

Note:
The in-round events (elites spawning/crates spawning) are now procedural, meaning you will feel the new gameplay slightly different, still under development, and balancing.

- Ali.
